C-CITATION-ANCHOR-REPAIR.IntentSummary: Insert delimiter-preserving HTML anchors on every F/D heading in docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md, rewrite in-scope fragments in two classes (mechanical then reading) so the reading diff is one pass, and ship scripts/validate-citation-anchors.ts on package.json validate:ci with planted refuse tests. No split, no registry write, no lint-domain expansion.

T-001.Title: Insert explicit anchors before every F/D heading

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Re-derive the F/D heading population at execution: every ATX heading (levels 1–6) whose text begins F or D. Tokenizer: line match ^#{1,6} [FD]\d. A two-level cut (^### F, ^## D) is refused. At plan authoring that population is 287 (F H3 202, F H4 27, D H2 22, D H3 36). Immediately before each such heading, on its own line, insert empty whose SLUG is the spec grammar: lowercase leading [FD](.)* with dots kept; qualifier suffix only on the non-canonical member of a same-token duplicate (F21 correction → f21-correction; F27.1 amendment → f27.1-amendment; F19's … → f19s). Heading text is byte-identical to HEAD. No fragment destinations change in this task. Failure conditions (mutations T-005 plants, this task must not ship): a heading with no preceding anchor; HTML inside the heading line; a {#id} suffix; id and name disagree; a two-level cut that skips H4 findings or H3 decisions; a strip-dot id; a qualifier suffix on a unique correction heading; two headings sharing an id.

T-002.Title: Mechanically restore dots on unique fragment destinations

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Re-derive the mechanical population: in-scope ](#f…) / ](#d…) destinations (token after f/d starts with a digit) whose strip-dot form matches exactly one F/D heading, and that heading's keep-dot slug differs from the current dest. Rewrite each to that keep-dot slug. At plan authoring: 38 distinct ids, 108 occurrences; specimens ](#f882) → ](#f88.2) and ](#d281) → ](#d28.1). Do not rewrite colliding-token dests (T-003) and do not change heading text or anchors. Failure conditions: a strip-dot destination left pointing at a keep-dot id it no longer names (T-005 plants ](#f882) against id=f88.2).

Verification.Command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md').read_text(); assert '](#f882)' not in t; assert '](#f88.2)' in t; assert '](#d281)' not in t; assert '](#d28.1)' in t; print('mechanical specimens ok')"

T-003.Title: Resolve colliding fragment destinations by reading

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Re-derive the reading population: in-scope fragments whose destination token (dots stripped) matches two or more F/D heading leading tokens. At plan authoring: 79 occurrences across 26 ids (d11 d12 d13 d14 d21 f101 f102 f112 f121 f122 f131 f132 f19 f21 f271 f51 f81 f82 f91 f92 f93 f94 f95 f96 f98 f99). Read each citing sentence and rewrite the dest to the keep-dot or qualifier slug of the heading it names. Rewrite in document order. This task's only decisions.md edits are those destination bytes, so the diff is the reading record in one pass. The verification listing is every in-scope fragment whose dest primary (leading [fd]<digits>(.<digits>)*) strip-dots to a colliding slug; at authoring that print set is 80 (the 79 plus #f21-correction, whose primary is f21). Re-derive. Do not write a parallel disambiguation table or any new inventory path. Failure conditions: a colliding token left as strip-dot so it silently binds to the un-dotted heading (uniqueness will not catch this; the printed listing is the check); a parallel table substituted for the corrected link.

Add scripts/validate-citation-anchors.ts. Production default targets exactly docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md and may take a path for fixtures. Exit 0 only when: every F/D heading at any ATX level has exactly one immediately preceding empty <a id name> whose id equals the spec grammar and equals name; ids are unique; every in-scope fragment resolves to exactly one existing id. Do not add a ngrace lint issue code. Do not edit src/grace-lint.ts, src/lint/core.ts, src/lint/catalog.ts, or src/language-registry.ts. scripts/ stays in ignoredDirs. Failure conditions (T-005 plants each): missing preceding anchor; duplicate id; unresolved fragment; strip-dot dest left against a keep-dot id; id and name disagree; HTML inside the heading line; {#id} suffix; strip-dot id; qualifier suffix on a unique correction heading; two-level cut omitting an H4 F or H3 D heading.

T-005.Title: Plant refuse-path tests for the validator

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add scripts/validate-citation-anchors.test.ts. Each spec Failure clause that the validator can observe is a planted mutation that must fail, and a happy fixture plus the live file must pass. Plant at least: missing preceding anchor; duplicate id; unresolved fragment; ](#f882) against id=f88.2; id and name disagree; HTML inside the heading line; {#id} suffix; strip-dot id on F9.1; qualifier suffix on a unique correction heading; fixture whose only F/D anchors follow a two-level cut and omit an H4 F heading. Also plant a unique-but-wrong fixture (#f93 with both F9.3 and F93 present as keep-dot ids) and assert the validator exits 0 — uniqueness cannot catch a wrong unique target (AC-AMBIGUOUS-READ). Do not treat that green as substantiation of the reading. Failure conditions: a planted refuse path that still exits 0; no live-file pass; a test that only prints ok.

T-006.Title: Join the validator to validate:ci and close the surgical diffs

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add named package.json script validate:citation-anchors whose command is bun ./scripts/validate-citation-anchors.ts and append bun run validate:citation-anchors to validate:ci. Do not bump version. Do not edit CONTRIBUTING.md (C-CI-CLAIM-PIN). git diff against HEAD has no changed path under docs/plans/archive/, .ngrace/changes/archive/, README.md, or examples/, and does not touch src/lint/catalog.ts, src/grace-lint.ts, src/lint/core.ts, or src/language-registry.ts. Failure conditions: the script exists but is not on the chain; only bun test covers it; the check lives in ngrace lint; any write under docs/plans/archive/ or .ngrace/changes/archive/; any README.md or examples/ edit; post-archive lint not 0/0.

Verification.Command: git diff --exit-code -- src/lint/catalog.ts src/grace-lint.ts src/lint/core.ts src/language-registry.ts
